score.comment: 1:0 reflects five of Mirassol's seven home wins coming by one goal, while 1:1 accounts for Mirassol's 18.8% home clean-sheet rate and Cuello-Bernard counter threat.

bqc.comment: High half-time draw rates for both clubs in tonight's venues point to a level interval before Mirassol's 11-day rest edge either breaks through late or settles into a tight stalemate.
